label.preflight.title: Pre-flight Check
label.preflight.itemDesc.battery:
Check appearance (no deformation)
Ensure balance lead connected
Cell voltage diff < 0.1V
If diff < 0.2V: charge at 16A
If diff > 0.2V: charge at 6A
label.preflight.itemDesc.propeller:
Check for cracks/deformation
Check screw marks, ensure no loosening
label.preflight.itemDesc.motor:
Rotate by hand, check debris/noise
Check rotation direction (if arms removed)
Check motor LED solid red/green (if arms removed)
Check screw marks, ensure no loosening
label.preflight.itemDesc.motorPropeller:
Motor:
Rotate by hand, check debris/noise
Check rotation direction (if arms removed)
Check motor LED solid red/green (if arms removed)
Check screw marks, ensure no loosening
Propeller/airframe:
Check for cracks/deformation
Check screw marks, ensure no loosening
label.preflight.itemDesc.airframe:
Check cracks/deformation
Tighten arm locks, ensure rubber fits tightly
Check anti-loosen rubber pad (if arms removed)
label.preflight.itemDesc.upperCover:
Check cracks/deformation
Ensure cover mounts are secure
label.preflight.itemDesc.winch:
Check knot/rope wear at hook
Check spool for tangles or reverse winding
label.preflight.itemDesc.aerialCamera:
Check lens for debris
Power on and check gimbal movement (if equipped)
label.preflight.itemDesc.antenna: Check marking parts are not loose
label.preflight.itemDesc.router: Working properly, SIM data sufficient (no photo required)
label.preflight.itemDesc.remoteServer: Working properly, server data sufficient (no photo required)
label.preflight.itemDesc.dockPosition: Position unchanged, powered on and online (no photo required)
label.preflight.itemDesc.rtk: Position unchanged, powered on and online (no photo required)
label.preflight.itemDesc.parachute:
Installed, LED solid red
Do not tilt UAV over 80° (if installed)
label.preflight.itemDesc.remoteServerM2M: Ensure tunneling program is running (no photo required)
